answers.question: What did SAME-R measure about smoke?
answers.text: SAME-R measured smoke particle sizes in microgravity to help tune future spacecraft fire detectors [PSI-101]. It examined smoke made from 5 materials, with smoke ageing for 21 s to 1,923 s before measurement [I9]. Smoke particles grow as smoke ages, and particle size affects whether a detector sees them [I9].
